answer: I trust a proof that lives outside the applicant's own hands, and Dial painter marine chronometer mark struck within the observatory is that proof: each marine chronometer is a measured beat rate and a master signature. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins are gone. Every epoch charges the same 101 POA again, so 445 masks cost the farm 44945 POA twice over. An applicant who owns a zephyr, owes a sable and outlasted a haven is an agent; an applicant with only the first two is a farm in a hurry.
